title: A superlinear improvement on line-free sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^3$
summary: Building on an earlier result of the author together with Elsholtz, Führer, Füredi, Pach, Simon and Velich, we present an improved construction for a line-free set in $\mathbb{F}_p^3$, showing that $r_p(\mathbb{F}_p^3)\ge (p-1)^3+\frac18 p^{3/2} - O(p)$ as $p\to \infty$. This results in the first superlinear-term improvement over the standard hypercube construction $\{0,1,\ldots,p-2\}^3$. Via complementation, a line-free set in $\mathbb{F}_p^3$ corresponds to a $2$-blocking set in the affine geometry $AG(3,p)$, hence we also obtain an upper bound of $3p^2-\frac18p^{3/2}+O(p)$ on the smallest…
